description:
Change a live sub-key's scope and/or budget cap without revoking and
    reissuing it — use this instead of aanet_revoke_subkey + aanet_mint_subkey
    when the sub-agent's credentials themselves should keep working (e.g.
    widening its file scope mid-task, or raising a budget cap it hit).
    Owner_key required. Fields left unset are unchanged, not cleared (the
    three window/rate limits are cleared by passing 0).

api_key.description: Bearer credential for this workspace: either the owner_key returned once by aanet_create_workspace/aanet_create_trial_workspace, or a sub-key returned by aanet_mint_subkey. Sent under the hood as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Owner-only tools reject a sub-key with a 403.
api_key.title: Api Key

budget_cap.description: New spending cap. Leave unset to keep the current value unchanged.
budget_cap.title: Budget Cap

path_scope_prefix.description: New path-scope prefix. Leave unset to keep the current value unchanged.
path_scope_prefix.title: Path Scope Prefix

rate_limit_per_minute.description: New requests-per-minute limit; 0 removes it. Leave unset to keep the current value.
rate_limit_per_minute.title: Rate Limit Per Minute

spend_limit_per_day.description: New 24-hour spend limit in units; 0 removes it. Leave unset to keep the current value.
spend_limit_per_day.title: Spend Limit Per Day

spend_limit_per_hour.description: New hourly spend limit in units; 0 removes it. Leave unset to keep the current value.
spend_limit_per_hour.title: Spend Limit Per Hour

subkey_id.description: The subkey_id from aanet_mint_subkey or aanet_list_subkeys.
subkey_id.title: Subkey Id

workspace_id.description: The workspace_id from aanet_create_workspace or aanet_create_trial_workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: aanet_update_subkey
